_help: Paste hosted checkout URLs here (Stripe Payment Links work well on GitHub Pages). Leave a url as an empty string until it is real — the page will show a clearly marked placeholder instead of a broken button. Each suggested amount should have its own link, because a payment link charges the price set in Stripe, not the number printed on the button. oneTimeUrl is an optional open-amount or single one-time gift. monthlyUrl should be a recurring payment link. See README.md.
